description: Build or refresh Vinv's semantic code index for THIS workspace. The build runs in the BACKGROUND and this call returns IMMEDIATELY with status — it never blocks. Call with no arguments to start/refresh the index and read its status; pass rebuild=true to force a full rebuild from scratch. Until the first build completes, vinv_query returns a "still indexing" notice, so call this once up front on a fresh workspace, then poll it for readiness.

rebuild.description: Force a full rebuild from scratch (default false: incremental update when an index already exists).

name: vinv_index
